project_type: Next.js 14+ app with localStorage-based data, feature-based architecture
build_system: npm with mise for Node.js version management. Run `mise trust && eval "$(mise activate bash)"` before npm commands. Node was installed with MISE_NODE_VERIFY=0.
test_command: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run test
verification_instructions: 1. Run `eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npx tsc --noEmit` to confirm no type errors. 2. Run `eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run lint` to confirm no lint errors. 3. Run `eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run test` to confirm tests pass.
setup_instructions: cd /projects/sandbox/CFA-Buddy && mise trust && MISE_NODE_VERIFY=0 mise install && eval "$(mise activate bash)"
environment_constraints: Node.js 22 managed via mise. Must run `mise trust` and `eval "$(mise activate bash)"` before any npm/npx commands.
contribution_requirements: Never use useSyncExternalStore. No TODOs, no placeholders. Feature-based folders (src/features/{name}/). No cross-feature imports except via @/ aliases.
key_patterns: Question data: each subject file exports a flat array (e.g. corporateIssuersQuestions: Question[]) and a modules object (e.g. corporateIssuersModules). Module arrays are named moduleNQuestions. Seed files: import modules object, define ModuleScoreConfig[], use seeded RNG to pick wrong questions, create PracticeAttempt and call saveAttempt(). The seed-guard.ts uses version key 'cfa-buddy-seeded-v6'. Three call sites wire seeds: dashboard-content.tsx, attempts-list-client.tsx, recent-attempts-section.tsx. Question loader only uses sampleQuestions from '../data/sample-questions'. Mock exam selector (src/features/mock-exam/utils/question-selector.ts) imports all subject arrays directly. Formula seed: array of FormulaEntry objects with id, name, subject, reading, formula, variables, example, topic, difficulty, examFrequency, optional keyTip.
directory_structure: src/features/question-bank/data/ = question data files per subject; src/features/question-bank/utils/ = seed files, loaders, storage; src/features/question-bank/types/ = type defs; src/features/formulas/data/ = formula seed; src/features/dashboard/components/ = dashboard that calls seeds; src/features/mock-exam/utils/ = mock exam question selector
